original.title: Rubrik Promotes Jesse Green to Chief Revenue Officer
original.excerpt: Brian McCarthy, President of Global Sales & Field Operations, resigned effective February 6, 2026; Jesse Green, previously President of Rubrik Americas, was promoted to Chief Revenue Officer.

proposedValue.title: Rubrik Promotes Jesse Green to Chief Revenue Officer
proposedValue.excerpt: Rubrik, the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced the promotion of Jesse Green to Chief Revenue Officer. Green, who successfully served as President, Rubrik Americas, now will lead the company’s global revenue organization to continue to scale and accelerate the company’s rapid growth and industry leadership. He succeeds Brian McCarthy, who leaves for another opportunity.
proposedValue.limitations: The retained release supports the promotion announcement dated February 4. It does not establish a resignation effective February 6 or McCarthy's prior title. The separately mentioned SEC filing is not part of this bound primary evidence.

proposedValue.text: WitnessAI raised $58 million in strategic funding led by Sound Ventures, with participation from Fin Capital, Samsung Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures and Forgepoint Capital Partners. The announcement also named Silver Buckshot Ventures as a new backer and Google Ventures and Ballistic Ventures as existing investors.

original.title: WitnessAI Raises $58M to Help Enterprises Move Faster with AI Safely
original.excerpt: WitnessAI raised a $58 million strategic funding round led by Sound Ventures, with Fin Capital, Samsung Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, Forgepoint Capital Partners, Silver Buckshot Ventures, and existing investors Google Ventures and Ballistic Ventures participating. The release states '500% ARR growth — just in the past 12 months' and headcount up 5x (unaudited).

proposedValue.title: WitnessAI Raises $58M to Help Enterprises Move Faster with AI Safely
proposedValue.excerpt: We’ve seen more than 500% ARR growth — just in the past 12 months, and expanded our headcount by 5x to support customer demand. Enterprises aren’t asking whether they’ll adopt AI anymore. They’re asking how to do it responsibly and at scale. They understand that progress and protection go hand-in-hand. It is what has guided us in every decision we’ve made. Today, we’re sharing a milestone in that journey. WitnessAI has raised $58 million in strategic funding, backed by one of the most diverse and thoughtfully assembled investor groups we could have imagined. We like to think of them as an armada — a coalition of perspectives spanning technology, finance, media, security, policy, and global scale. The round was led by Sound Ventures, with participation from leading strategic investors including Fin Capital, the leading fintech firm backing category-defining financial services and infrastructure platforms; Samsung Ventures and Qualcomm Ventures; and cybersecurity fund Forgepoint Capital Partners. We’re also proud to bring on angels like Silver Buckshot Ventures, the cyber moonshot fund founded by bestselling cybersecurity author and journalist Nicole Perlroth. Together, they join our existing investors Google Ventures and Ballistic Ventures.
proposedValue.limitations: Company blog. Google Ventures and Ballistic Ventures are named as existing investors; current-round participation by them is not established.
